newsitem.title: USA: ITT amends terms of equity self-tender.
newsitem.headline: ITT amends terms of equity self-tender.

text.p: ITT Corp said on Monday it had amended its self-tender offer to remove procedures for tendering shares by guaranteed delivery in order to accelerate calculation of the final pro rata factor for the offer.

ITT last Thursday rejected Hilton Hotels Corp offer of $8.3 billion, or $70 a share, for the hotel, gaming and entertainment company. Hilton had raised its bid from its original offer of $55 a share, made in January.
ITT recently extended its tender offer to buy up to 30 million of its shares, or 26 percent of its outstanding stock, for $70 per share, until September 9.

It said on Monday that shareholders may not use the notice of guaranteed delivery previously circulated to tender shares and that the depository for the offer will not accept shares tendered after the expiration of the offer.
A Hilton spokesman said the removal of the guaranteed delivery procedures was a tactic to coerce shareholders into tendering their shares soon to create a false referendum.
As of August 12, ITT had collected 19 million shares in the tender offer, part of a reorganisation that calls for dividing the company into three entities.
ITT also said shareholders who purchase their shares three trading days or less prior to the expiration of the offer may be unable to tender their shares unless a special arrangement is made.
